row: The Ark of San Juan Companion Animal Rescue

The Ark of San Juan Companion Animal Rescue is a 100% volunteer organization based in San Juan Capistrano, California. We are a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit group and our Tax ID number is 83-0493818. Our mission is to rescue the lost and forgotten animals and provide much needed food, shelter, medical attention, foster homes and adoption for them using 100% of the money and supplies donated to us for these purposes. Please visit our website for complete information www.ArkofSanJuan.org.
